menu.name: Sweet and Sour Shrimp with White Rice
menu.description: Sweet and Sour Shrimp is a beloved Cambodian stir-fry featuring succulent shrimp cooked in a vibrant tangy sauce with tomato paste tamarind and vinegar balanced with sugar creating a perfect harmony of sweet sour and savory flavors served with fresh vegetables

menu.name: Stir-Fried Sweet and Sour Squid with White Rice
menu.description: Stir-Fried Sweet and Sour Squid is a popular and vibrant Asian dish that perfectly balances fresh tender squid rings with a colorful medley of crisp vegetables in a rich tangy sauce

menu.name: Stir-Fried Shrimp with Green Peppercorns with White Rice
menu.description: Taste the perfect combination of juicy succulent shrimp tossed with aromatic whole sprigs of young green peppercorns. Coated in a rich savory garlic-oyster sauce glaze with just the right touch of mild herbal heat, every bite is a burst of fresh coastal flavor. Pair it with warm jasmine rice for the ultimate comfort meal

menu.name: Stir-Fried Squid with Fresh Green Peppercorns with White Rice
menu.description: Tender perfectly scored squid rings flashed-fried with whole aromatic sprigs of young green peppercorns crisp bell peppers and fresh garlic. Coated in a rich glossy savory glaze delivering mild citrusy heat that complements the fresh seafood. A coastal favorite that pairs beautifully with warm rice.

menu.name: Stir-Fried Shrimp with Holy Basil with White Rice
menu.description: This dish packs a punch with juicy succulent shrimp flash-fried alongside fragrant holy basil leaves fresh garlic and fiery crushed chilies. Coated in a perfectly balanced savory-sweet sauce every bite delivers that signature smoky peppery aroma that makes this an ultimate street-food classic. Best enjoyed over a bed of warm jasmine rice

menu.name: Stir-Fried Minced Pork with Holy Basil with White Rice
menu.description: This legendary street-food classic features juicy minced pork flash-fried with aromatic holy basil leaves, fresh garlic, and fiery chilies. Coated in a perfectly balanced savory sauce, it delivers that signature smoky, peppery aroma that will keep you coming back for more. Best served over warm jasmine rice with a crispy fried egg on top

menu.name: Stir-Fried Spicy Frog with White Rice
menu.description: This traditional Cambodian favorite features tender juicy frog meat flash-fried with an aromatic explosion of lemongrass paste Kroeung fresh garlic fiery chilies and wild holy basil. Coated in a rich deeply savory sauce with a kick of heat it is the ultimate comfort dish for anyone who loves bold smoky flavors. Pair it with warm jasmine rice for the perfect bite

menu.name: Stir-Fried Spicy Shrimp with White Rice
menu.description: This dish features juicy, succulent shrimp flash-fried in a fiery and fragrant blend of lemongrass paste, fresh garlic, sliced chilies, and wild holy basil. Coated in a rich, deeply savory sauce that carries a smoky, herbal kick, it delivers the perfect balance of fresh seafood and bold local spices. Enjoy it hot over a steaming bed of jasmine rice!

menu.name: Stir-Fried Spicy Beef with White Rice
menu.description: This traditional favorite features tender, juicy slices of beef flash-fried in a searing wok with a fragrant lemongrass paste, fresh garlic, fiery chilies, and wild holy basil. Coated in a rich, deeply savory sauce that carries a smoky, herbal kick, it delivers the perfect balance of savory richness and bold spice. Enjoy it piping hot over a steaming bed of jasmine rice!

menu.name: Stir-Fried Spicy Squid with White Rice
menu.description: This dish features tender, perfectly scored squid rings flash-fried in a searing wok with an aromatic Cambodian lemongrass paste, fresh garlic, crushed chilies, and wild holy basil. Coated in a rich, deeply savory sauce that carries a smoky, herbal kick, it delivers the ultimate balance of snappy seafood texture and bold spice. Best enjoyed piping hot over a steaming bed of jasmine rice!

menu.name: Beef Lok Lak with White Rice
menu.description: Beef Lok Lak (ឆាឡុកឡាក់សាច់គោ)! This beloved classic features premium cubes of tender, juicy beef flash-fried in a roaring wok to lock in all the rich, savory-sweet flavors. Served over a fresh bed of crisp lettuce, sliced tomatoes, and onions, it comes complete with your choice of steamed or fried rice. Don't forget to dip the succulent beef into our famous lime and Kampot pepper sauce for that perfect tangy kick!

menu.name: River Prawns in Coconut Sauce with White Rice
menu.description: Fresh, sweet, and meaty river prawns are gently simmered in a rich, velvety coconut cream reduction infused with fragrant lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, and a hint of local spices. This dish delivers a masterful balance of savory richness, natural sweetness, and a subtle herbal aroma that coats every juicy bite. Perfectly paired with a warm bowl of jasmine rice for the ultimate comfort luxury!

menu.name: Beef Fried Rice
menu.description: Jasmine rice is tossed in a roaring wok to capture that perfect, smoky "wok hei" aroma, then combined with tender, juicy slices of marinated beef, scrambled eggs, and a colorful mix of veggies. Every single bite is packed with savory goodness and a melt-in-your-mouth texture. It's a quick, delicious, and deeply satisfying meal that never disappoints!

menu.name: Seafood Fried Rice
menu.description: We toss premium jasmine rice in a roaring wok to capture that perfect, smoky "wok hei" aroma, then load it up with plump, juicy shrimp, tender squid rings, and scrambled eggs. Every single bite delivers a masterful balance of savory richness and fresh, snappy coastal flavors.

menu.name: Grilled Beef with Prohok Sauce
menu.description: Tender, juicy cuts of marinated beef are grilled over hot coals to achieve a perfect smoky char. The star of the dish is our authentic, bold, and fiery Prohok dipping sauce

menu.name: Seafood Tom Yum
menu.description: This iconic soup features a piping hot, vibrant broth that strikes the perfect, legendary balance of spicy, sour, and savory notes. Slow-simmered with aromatic lemongrass, galangal, and kaffir lime leaves, it is loaded with plump, juicy shrimp, tender squid rings, and fresh mushrooms.

menu.name: Cambodian Lemongrass Beef Sour Soup
menu.description: This beloved classic features a piping hot, robust broth slow-simmered with freshly pounded Kroeung (lemongrass, galangal, and turmeric paste) and a savory touch of fermented fish paste. Loaded with tender slices of marinated beef and crisp water spinach, it delivers a masterful balance of bold herbal aromas and a bright, tangy finish.

menu.name: Trey Nhean Set (ឈុតត្រីញៀន)!
menu.description: This iconic coastal classic features freshly caught, premium local fish sliced thinly and enjoyed raw. The magic comes together when you dip the delicate, naturally sweet fish meat into our fiery house chili sauce a masterful local blend of lime, garlic, sugar, and crushed chilies. Served as a generous platter complete with aromatic crispy fried garlic and a vibrant mountain of fresh wild herbs and crisp veggies (banana blossoms, betel leaves, and cabbage)

menu.name: Special Seafood Papaya Salad (បុកល្ហុងគ្រឿងសមុទ្រពិសេស)!
menu.description: Crisp, shredded green papaya is pounded fresh to order and loaded with a generous, premium mix of plump, juicy shrimp and tender, snappy squid rings. Tossed in a vibrant, mouth-watering dressing of fresh lime juice, fiery chilies, and a savory local umami kick, it delivers the perfect explosion of crunch, intense heat, and fresh coastal flavors.

menu.name: Seafood Papaya Salad (បុកល្ហុងគ្រឿងសមុទ្រ)!
menu.description: Shredded, crisp green papaya is pounded fresh to order and mixed with a delicious serving of juicy shrimp and tender squid rings. Tossed in a vibrant dressing of fresh lime juice, garlic, and fiery chilies, every bite delivers a perfect harmony of refreshing crunch, savory richness, and a bold, spicy kick.

menu.name: Cambodian Shrimp Salad (ភ្លាបង្គា)!
menu.description: Plump, succulent shrimp tossed fresh to order with a fragrant aromatic mix of finely shaved lemongrass, shallots, kaffir lime leaves, and fresh local herbs. Drenched in a fiery lime-infused sweet-and-sour dressing with a kick of crushed bird's eye chilies, it delivers the perfect balance of natural seafood sweetness and bold bright spice.

menu.name: Cambodian Beef Salad (ភ្លាសាច់គោ)!
menu.description: Cambodian Beef Salad (ភ្លាសាច់គោ)! Thin, succulent slices of premium beef are flash-cooked to lock in their natural sweetness, then tossed fresh with an aromatic mix of finely shaved lemongrass, shallots, kaffir lime leaves, and wild local herbs.

menu.name: Cambodian-Style Beef Larb (ឡាបសាច់គោ)!
menu.description: Cambodian-Style Beef Larb (ឡាបសាច់គោ)! This minced steak salad features tender, juicy slices of beef tossed with fresh shallots, mint, and local herbs. The dish is brought to life with a zesty dressing of fresh lime juice, fish sauce, fiery crushed chilies, and the essential addition of crunchy toasted ground rice for that signature smoky aroma.

menu.name: Beef Tripe and Banana Blossom Salad (ញាំពោះគោត្រយ៉ូងចេក)!
menu.description: Beef Tripe and Banana Blossom Salad (ញាំពោះគោត្រយ៉ូងចេក)! This local favorite features clean, tenderly prepared beef tripe tossed fresh to order with finely shredded, crisp banana blossoms and a mountain of aromatic wild herbs.

menu.name: Seafood Glass Needle Salad (ញាំមីសួរគ្រឿងសមុទ្រ)
menu.description: Delicate chewy glass noodles tossed fresh to order with plump juicy shrimp tender squid rings and crisp garden vegetables. Drenched in a bold zesty sweet-and-sour dressing infused with fresh lime juice garlic and fiery crushed bird's eye chilies delivering a perfect harmony of refreshing textures and intense local umami.

menu.name: Pounded Beef with Rice Paddy Herb (សាច់គោបុកម្អម)!
menu.description: Pounded Beef with Rice Paddy Herb (សាច់គោបុកម្អម)! Tender, succulent slices of grilled beef are gently pounded in a mortar to absorb a vibrant mixture of fresh garlic, fiery bird's eye chilies, and the star ingredient - Ma'om (Rice Paddy Herb), known for its distinctly bright, citrusy, and cumin-like aroma.
